newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end first day weaker.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end first day weaker.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures finished an abbreviated first business day of the year weaker across the board on Monday, shrugging off the yen's further weakness against the dollar, traders said.
Rubber prices ranged from 1.2 yen to 2.3 yen per kg lower. Benchmark June ended 1.2 yen lower at 148.7 yen.

"Caution that prices were too high after the benchmark reached 150 yen at the end of last year prompted investors to take profits," one trader said. "The market lacked energy to make fresh buying, although overall sentiment has improved," he added.--Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7431
